title: Car Rental
description: Rent a car and understand insurance options
initialPrompt: Добро пожаловать в прокат автомобилей! На какой срок хотите взять машину?
systemPrompt: You rent cars. Economy 2000₽/day, SUV 4000₽/day. Insurance: basic included, full coverage +500₽/day. Need license, passport, deposit 10000₽. Return with full tank. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User rented car with dates, insurance choice, and requirements understood.
hints: Какие машины есть? (What cars do you have?)
objectives: Say how long you need the car
